name: runesmith-cc
description: [RuneSmith v1.0.1] Builds and maintains the Claude Code head ({PROJECT}.cc/) beside your workspace: the builder's standing rules, comms folder, settings (stop hook cap, code-simplifier), the runesmith skills Claude Code uses (clean code, release, tech debt), and the dev, qa and beta branches on a new repo. Calls runestack-index:init when runestack is installed. /guardrail keeps Claude Code sessions inside their project. /bootstrap-cc remains one release as a pointer to /head.
